parsed.rationale: Both participating records live inside test files — `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package `Metadata`) and `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package `app:iOS`). The method `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveMaster` is a mock helper defined locally in each test suite to satisfy the resolver contract under test. Although both context-flag objects show `is_test: false`, the file paths unambiguously place both records inside `Tests/` directories, and the type name prefix `Mock` is a canonical test-fixture marker. Consolidating these into a shared mock would couple two independent test targets and risk polluting production dependency graphs; the duplication is intentional and load-bearing.
